Name: Blue Grass Recolor
Author: collingbe
Description:
[color=#f4f4f4] [/color][size=2]This is the first mod i've made :D after two remakes, i'm finally confident enough to release this mod.[/size]
[size=4]
[color=#ffff00][b]HUGE [/b][/color][/size][size=3][b]thank you[/b] to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/127116523]inmognito[/url] for making the recolor for pine, mahogany and palm trees!!
link:﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12310/]Extra Trees for the Blue Grass Recolor[/url][/size]


[b][color=#ffff00]1.0.3 UPDATE:[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]updated for 1.6. Added Pine, Mahogany and palm trees.
[*]1.6更新。增加了松树，桃花心木树和椰树。
[*]1.6 업데이트. 소나무, 마호가니 나무, 그리고 야자수가 추가되었습니다
[/list]

[b][color=#ffff00]1.0.2 UPDATE:[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]updated for the new version of daisyniko tilesheets recolor, now theres no need for manual replacement.
[*]更新了黛西妮可新版的改色，现在不需要手动替换了。
[/list]


[b][color=#ffff00]1.0.1 UPDATE:[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]now includes wild grass.        
[*][s]ive included an content.json file in the optional file tab, which includes code for the other plantable trees. To use it, first replace the file in the blue grass mod folder, then you can add pngs to the assets/TerrainFeatures folder. The names of the pngs should be:[/s]
[/list][list=1]
[*][s]mushroom_tree.png[/s]
[*][s]tree_palm.png    and    tree_palm2.png[/s]
[*][s]tree3_fall.png     tree3_spring.png     tree3_summer.png     tree3_winter.[/s]
[*][s]tree8_fall.png     tree8_spring.png     tree8_summer.png     tree8_winter.png[/s]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]添加了牧草改色[/size]
[*][size=3][s]可选下载里新增了一个content.json文件，替换蓝草mod文件夹里的同名文件后可以识别assets/TerrainFeatures 文件夹里的其他树。具体使用方法：把你想使用的树的png文件放进assets/TerrainFeatures 文件夹里，确保树的名字和上述的一样。[/s][/size]
[/list]


[size=4]Please read!![/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]building recolors are not included in this mod, but you can use whatever map recolor(or building recolor) that modifies building with this mod, as long as this mod is alphabetically lower in your mod folder (for example, the folder of this mod starts with b, so it's lower than all mods that starts with a). [b][color=#ffff00]PLEASE NOTE[/color][/b] that compatibility is [b][color=#ff0000]NOT[/color][/b] 100 percent guaranteed! for example, [s]if you use project yellog's town overhaul with this mod, some areas might look abit weird.[/s][/size]
[*][size=3][s]I've included codes to replace the static pine trees, however i did not draw the asset for the pine tree, because A: i really like the cloud trees by ERRORcauser, and B: at this point id rather write an essay than draw another tree. [/s][/size]
[*][size=3][s][b][color=#ffff00]TO REPLACE THE STATIC PINE TREE[/color] [/b]prepare whatever tree you want to use (must be png, can be optained from any cp version of tree mods), rename the trees as "tree1_spring.png", "tree1_summer.png" etc, then put the four pngs in the Map folder. The trees should show up fine.[/s][/size]
[*][size=3][s]For the plantable trees, ive included two trees, maple and oak. They correspond to tree 1 and tree 2. You can use whatever tree replacement mod you want with this mod, either CP or xnb. But if you use cp you must delete the tree 1 and 2 from my mod or the other mod.[/s][/size]
[/list]
Please don't hesitate to reach out if you've encountered a bug, or have any suggestions!
If you would like me to make a compatible version with another mod, please comment or DM me, i will try my best to make one :D

Yellog's wood buildings.

[/url]﻿
﻿Credits:[/size][/b][b][size=3]Some plant assets used are from DustBeauty's stardew foliage redone﻿﻿

[/size][/b]经过了两次重置，我终于决定在n网发布蓝草了。这是我做的第一个mod，从一开始什么都不懂到现在勉强能做一些mod经历了很多。真的很感谢喜欢我的mod的各位，特别是b站up主[b][color=#d5a6bd][size=4]小小桃纸哟[/size][/color][/b]的内测和宣传！姐妹们不要放过这个宝藏up主，快去关注她！

[size=3][b]使用前必读！！[/b]
[list]
[*]蓝草没有改动任何房屋，所以理论上可以和任何改动房屋的地图改色一起使用，但是在你mod文件夹的位置必须比其他改色的位置低（比如蓝草的文件夹开头是B，那么其他改色的开头必须是A。）不过[color=#ffff00][b]请注意[/b][/color]这不代表和其他改色是[color=#ff0000]百分百兼容[/color][color=#f4f4f4]， [s]特别是像yellog这种改动房屋形状的mod。[/s][/color]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][s]我写了改松树的代码，但是我实在是不想再画一棵树了（喂）。在截图里我用的是[b][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1211?tab=description]Magica Trees[/url]。[/size][/b][/s][/color]
[*][s][b][color=#ffff00]如何替换静态松树[/color][color=#f4f4f4]: [/color][/b][color=#f4f4f4]首先准备好你想用的树（必须是png格式，可以从别的cp模式的树里扒出来），把树的名字改成 "tree1_spring.png", "tree1_summer.png" 这种格式，然后把四张png放进Map文件夹里。[/color][/s]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][s]可种植/砍的树的美化我只做了两个，分别是枫树和榆树，也就是tree 1 和 tree 2。如果你想用其他树的美化，xnb可以直接替换没有问题，但是用cp格式的话要么删我的mod里两棵树，要么删另一个mod的两棵树。[/s][/color]
[/list][color=#f4f4f4]

如果在使用该mod时遇到了任何问题，或者有任何建议，欢迎随时戳我！
严禁二传和盗卖，蓝草以前小范围分享已经经历过几次盗卖了，如果被我发现有人盗卖，我将永远下架蓝草。
